statement: At pinned HHD adbd50ff, the virtual DualSense implementation creates a Linux UHID device with Sony VID 0x054C and standard DualSense PID 0x0CE6 or Edge PID 0x0DF2 (Edge default), choosing BUS_BLUETOOTH 0x05 by default or BUS_USB 0x03 optionally. It selects an Edge-labelled descriptor variant matching that bus, with gamepad inputs and feature-report declarations; the UHID helper synthesizes distinct ephemeral uniq and phys strings unless explicitly supplied. This does not create an actual Bluetooth radio connection or USB gadget topology.

applicability.revision: HHD adbd50ff and SDL 3.4.18 compatibility source, no independent DualSense hardware comparison
applicability.scope: evidence_role: consumer. HHD virtual DualSense __init__.py 67-152; const.py 5-30, 180 onward (USB and Bluetooth report descriptors); uhid.py 21-26 and 193-220. Neither raw identifier data nor descriptor byte arrays copied.
